verdict.rationale: BugSnag publishes a documented Data Access REST API as an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec on SwaggerHub, covering errors, projects and organization data. Its developer portal reference includes Authentication, Pagination, Rate Limiting and Versioning pages, so listing and querying errors is evidenced. The evidence never explicitly shows updating issues, fetching raw individual events, or permission-scoped tokens. The 404s on docs.bugsnag.com OpenAPI paths only mean the spec is hosted elsewhere and do not contradict it. Missing for 10: documented issue update/status-change endpoints, raw event retrieval endpoints, evidence of scoped/least-privilege API tokens, independent hands-on corroboration.
